title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 207 ]

blocks.text: The job of Congress is to pass laws. Before a bill becomes a law, it must be approved by both houses of Congress and by the president. If the president rejects a bill, it can still become a law if the president's rejection is overridden by at least a two-thirds majority of each house of Congress.

readingSentences.english: The job of Congress is to pass laws.
Before a bill becomes a law, it must be approved by both houses of Congress and by the president.
readingSentences.korean: 법안이 법률이 되기 전에 그것은 의회의 상하 양원과 대통령 모두의 승인을 받아야 한다.

readingSentences.english: If the president rejects a bill, it can still become a law if the president's rejection is overridden by at least a two-thirds majority of each house of Congress.
readingSentences.korean: 대통령이 법안을 거부하더라도, 대통령의 거부가 의회 각 원의 최소 3분의 2 이상의 찬성으로 무효화되면 여전히 법률이 될 수 있다.
